{{See also|Raspberry_Pi_Compute_Module_5_(CM5104032)}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RK3588 @2.4GHz Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A76) :+ @1.8GHz Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A55) *GPU: ''Mali-G610'' MP4 (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.2); NPU Support 6T, :VPU (with 8K@60fps VP9 and 8K@30fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 32GB eMMC 5.1 flash *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Power Source: 5V via connectors
